scientific_integrity: The finite certificate enumerates every perfect matching and every face, verifies acyclic discrete-Morse reductions and exact integral boundary unit pivots. No independent external mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact homotopy theorem only for Q4 = C4 Cartesian C4; no claim for all hypercubes, rectangular grids, or equivariant/inclusion maps. Non-indexed equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: Perfect-matching complex of the four-cube: \(54\) three-spheres and \(21\) four-spheres
